rain_day: the rain streaks thin out over about 40 rows near y 340..380, and the lower sky band is clean (landed keeps its streaks down to the hills). There is no hard line at full size; the streaks stay faint at thumbnail size (rain_day_streak_edge.png).

Near-camera puddles in town_night_rain and seam_day show a beige, blocky, straight-edged reflection of the house. Option 4, round 4 and landed show the same blob, so it is not new (rain_nearpuddle_compare.png).

AITEST gaps: (a) the call site in World::SimulateLandscape is checked by string only for presence and order, not that the call is unconditional, so a render-state guard round SimulateFogSight(GLOB_LAND) would pass every test; (b) Target.cpp CalcVisibility's multiply is also checked by string only and never executed, so a render condition wrapped round it would pass; (c) exposure, saturation and sun are not varied through the real step, only in the pure ComputeFogMedium. No log of the fixer's mutation run is on disk, but reading the code agrees with the claim.
